# ovirt_datacenter (Resource)

The ovirt_datacenter resource creates and manages datacenters in oVirt.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "ovirt_datacenter" "test" {
  name        = "my-datacenter"
  description = "Production Datacenter"
  comment     = "Managed by Terraform"
  local       = false
  quota_mode  = "audit"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) User-provided name for the datacenter.

### Optional

- `comment` (String) User-provided comment for the datacenter.
- `description` (String) User-provided description for the datacenter.
- `local` (Boolean) Whether the datacenter uses local storage (true) or shared storage (false). Defaults to false.
- `quota_mode` (String) Quota enforcement mode for the datacenter. Valid values: `disabled`, `audit`, `enabled`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) oVirt ID of this datacenter.
